subject: Observability packaging: retention, trace egress & dashboard SKU flexibility
messages:
From: Sam Keller <sam.keller@stratoai.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwoodai.com
Cc: Olivia Park <olivia.park@stratoai.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Observability add-ons — need pricing clarity and potential discount

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the new tracing UI and the advanced dashboard templates look promising. We're trying to size the overall spend if we increase retention and enable the tracing egress. Two quick asks so we can model this for finance: 

1) If we move from 30d to 90d trace retention for our production cluster (approx. 2TB compressed / month now), what is the expected delta in observability add-on cost?
2) Can we get a worked example for tracing egress (we would expect ~1.2M traces/month exported to our partner analytics pipeline)?
3) For Advanced Dashboards, what are the SKU limits (seats, saved dashboards) and do you offer a bundle discount when purchased together with the retention/tracing add-ons?

We have a Q3 procurement window and are budgeting a commit, but we'll need some concession room — any discount corridor you can share up-front? I'm attaching the latest SOW and our Q2 usage report.

Appreciate a short options list we can review with finance.

Best,
Sam
Sam Keller
Head of Platform
StratoAI
Attachments: SOW_StratoAI_v3.pdf (application/pdf), usage_report_q2.csv (text/csv)

From: jonas_weber@redwoodai.com
To: Sam Keller <sam.keller@stratoai.com>
Cc: Olivia Park <olivia.park@stratoai.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Aug 2027 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons — need pricing clarity and potential discount

Sam — thanks for the details and the attachments. Quick read-through and a couple clarifying Qs before I propose numbers:

- Is the 2TB/month compressed an average or a peak? That affects retention amortization.
- For DAGs you export, are all traces full-span payloads or sampled traces (i.e., do you expect full payload export for 100% of traces)?

High level, we typically offer two packaging approaches for observability addons: 1) Slab (fixed retention + fixed trace cap) with a commit discount, or 2) Metered (pay for actual retention/egress consumed) with lower upfront commitment.

Rough illustrations (ballpark, subject to confirmation):
- Slab bundle: 90d retention for up to 2.5TB/month compressed + 1M trace egress/month + Advanced Dashboards (10 seats) — list price $28k/mo. With a 12-month revenue commit we can offer a 15% discount.
- Metered: baseline 30d retention included, extra retention at $0.12/GB-month, egress at $0.015/trace. No commit discount; good for pilots.

I'll loop in Marissa and Karthik internally to confirm whether we can extend beyond 15% for a mid-market contract — I know there is some flexibility tied to total ACV and committed months. Expect a follow-up with two polished options by Monday.

Best,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: jonas_weber@redwoodai.com
To: marissa_cole@redwoodai.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodai.com
Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2027 08:11:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Observability add-ons — need pricing clarity and potential discount

Marissa / Karthik — forwarding Sam's ask (StratoAI). Key facts: approx 2TB/month compressed, want 90d retention and ~1.2M traces exported monthly. They have a Q3 procurement window and would sign a commit if we can land concession.

Proposed two-option offer (internal):
- Option A (12-month commit): Slab bundle — 90d retention (2.5TB/month cushion), 1.0M trace egress, Advanced Dashboards (10 seats), list $28k/mo. Concession: up to 18% discount and 3 months of migration credits (credits cover retention delta for first 3 months).
- Option B (Pilot Metered): 30d baseline, retention overage at $0.10/GB-month (intro rate), egress at $0.012/trace, no long-term discount, but 1 month of free trace egress credits to help transition.

Notes: If they push for 20% we should ask for a 24-month commit or add a quarterly usage SLA (minimum monthly). Also confirm whether billing needs to be annual prepaid (preferred) or monthly invoiced.

Can you confirm margin on Option A at 18% discount and whether legal needs to prep an amendment for retention SLAs?

Jonas

From: jonas_weber@redwoodai.com

Cc: Olivia Park <olivia.park@stratoai.com>, marissa_cole@redwoodai.com
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 10:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons — need pricing clarity and potential discount

Sam / Olivia — thanks for waiting. Based on your Q2 usage and our internal pricing review here are two concrete options you can present to finance. I kept them simple to make comparisons straightforward.

Option 1 — Enterprise Observability Bundle (recommended if you want predictability)
- 90-day trace retention, allowance 2.5TB/month compressed
- Tracing egress: 1.0M exported traces/month included
- Advanced Dashboards: 10 seats + 50 saved dashboards
- Price (list): $28,000/month ($336,000 annual).
- Committed discount: 18% for 12 months (ACV: $275,520). Includes 3 months of migration credits to offset the retention ramp.
- SLA: 99.95% availability for observability UI and trace ingest; priority support during onboarding.

Option 2 — Transition Metered Plan (lower commitment)
- Baseline: 30-day retention included
- Retention overage: $0.10/GB-month (intro rate)
- Tracing egress: $0.012/trace for exports beyond 100k/month (first 100k free to assist pilot)
- Advanced Dashboards: add-on at $2,400/month for up to 10 seats
- No term discount; month-to-month rolling billing.

Concessions / Win Conditions
- We can sign at 18% if you commit to 12 months and agree to annual invoicing. If StratoAI wants 20% discount, we'd need either a 24-month term or a minimum quarterly prepayment.
- We will include onboarding credits (3 months) for data migration and a one-time dashboard migration assist (up to 8 hours).

Next steps
- If you want the Enterprise Bundle, reply with "Option 1 accepted" and I'll get a DocuSign ready with the amendment and implementation schedule.
- If you'd like to pilot, reply with "Option 2 pilot" and we'll set up a 30-day technical onboarding plan.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30-minute call this week to walk finance through the numbers.

Warmly,
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
